title: Marketplace compliance, localization and launch handoff for AWS & GCP storefronts
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Prepare and hand off all localization, legal/compliance, billing SKU mapping and launch-ready assets for AWS and GCP marketplace listings so Partner Ops and Sales can initiate private offers and public storefront publishing. This ticket consolidates cross-functional requirements (legal, security, engineering packaging, design assets, pricing & billing) and creates the final checklist and roll-forward plan for the launch window. Scope includes: translation of listing copy and UI screenshots, legal & AUP signoffs for marketplace terms, marketplace-specific packaging (GCP deployment package & AWS AMI/CloudFormation listing), SKU pricing matrix, and the release notes bundle for both public and private offer flows.
acceptance_criteria: All marketplace listing copy translated to supported locales (en-US, en-GB, de-DE, fr-FR) and reviewed by PM and Legal
Legal/compliance signoff recorded in Confluence with link to executed Marketplace Agreements
Billing SKU matrix completed and validated with Finance (pricing, meter IDs, currency rounding rules)
Technical packaging artifacts present in partner repos: AWS AMI manifest + CloudFormation listing YAML, GCP Deployment package and marketplace.json
Design assets (hero screenshot, 3 thumbnails, icons) exported per marketplace spec and uploaded to Drive
Release notes and launch messaging bundle drafted and approved for both public release and private-offer templates
Launch playbook created with step-by-step publish checklist, rollback criteria, and contact on-call list
tasks: Create localization spreadsheet and assign translators (PM)
Collect existing release notes and distill 2-3 bullet TL;DR for marketplace summary (PM)
Legal to provide marketplace contract checklist and confirm required disclosures (Legal)
Engineering to produce marketplace packaging artifacts and post build links (ENG)
Design to produce screenshots and icons per AWS/GCP spec and export 2 sizes for retina displays (DES)
Finance to validate SKU and pricing matrix and confirm currency support (Fin)
Partner Ops to run dry-run private offer in AWS with test account and confirm billing flow (Partner Ops)
Create final Confluence launch playbook and tag required approvers for signoff (PM)
Schedule go/no-go review 48 hours before due_date and collect approvals (PM)
Draft customer-facing release notes and internal rollout email templates (PM/Comms)
